Peripheral SR-B1and ABCG1 facilitate cholesterol transfer from

LCAT esteriﬁes cholesterol in nascent HDL to cholesteryl ester to prevent cholesterol release.
The nascent HDL
matures to HDL3 with the accumulation of cholesteryl esters and eventually to HDL2.
Mature HDL2 is converted back to HDL3 by depositing
cholesteryl esters, phospholipids, and TG in the liver for excretion or lipoprotein synthesis.
